parent.title: Parent workspace
parent.intro: Book a 15-minute interview with a teacher who published availability for that subject and grade. Times use the school time zone ({{tz}}).
parent.requestTeacherNote: director approval required; you will sign in again after approval.
parent.noSlots: No open slots for that day.
parent.subject: Subject
parent.cancelConfirm: Cancel this interview? You can only cancel before the day of the meeting (school calendar).
parent.noCancel: No online cancel (day of or past)

meetingProfile.title: Meeting registration
meetingProfile.intro: Before booking, save the student school email, who will attend the interview, and their relationship to the student.

requestTeacher.title: Request teacher access
requestTeacher.intro: Submit a request to the school director. If approved, your account will be promoted to teacher after you sign in again.
requestTeacher.submitted: Request submitted. A director will review it.

teacher.title: Teacher workspace
teacher.intro: Create one offering per subject/course/grade combination. Parents book fixed 15-minute slots inside the weekly windows you publish. All times use the school zone {{tz}}.
teacher.subject: Subject
teacher.weeklyHint: This replaces all weekly windows for the selected offering. Use 24h HH:mm in {{tz}}.

director.title: Director workspace
director.intro: Set the school time zone and UI language, approve teacher access, maintain subjects, assign offerings, and review all visits (including cancellations).
director.schoolTzHint: IANA id: slots, weekly windows, and calendars follow this zone. Filter the list, pick a value, or type a valid id.
director.accessHint: Parents who asked to become teachers. After approval they must sign in again to get a teacher token.
director.name: Name
director.createOfferingHint: Use section (e.g. A, C) to separate parallel groups in the same grade.
director.weeklyDirHint: Replaces all windows for the chosen offering (same as teacher self-service). Use 24h HH:mm in {{tz}}.
director.visitAuditHint: Filter by student school email to see counts of total vs cancelled visits for that student.
